name: ELO_145AB_PushButton_CircuitI_2Wire
description: Push button switch 145...AB, M30 contactless reed pushbutton, Circuit I (simple N.O. contact, no LED), AMP Superseal connector.
notes: Pinout/circuit is Circuit I from the ordering key ('145 0 0 0 A B' = Circuit I, N.O., AMP Superseal connector). The datasheet's connector drawing shows a shared 3-pole AMP-Super-Seal shell across the family, but Circuit I only uses 2 contacts; this file models the connector as 2 cavities (pin 3 is used on the Circuit IX/LED variant only, modeled separately). Max. switching current is not explicitly stated in the datasheet article-characteristics table; derived here as 10 VA / 36 V ≈ 0.28 A — verify against the exact ordering-key suffix (circuit/color/connector) before production use.

connectors.name: X1
connectors.mounting: M30x1 threaded body, SW36 nut, AMP-Super-Seal shell (Circuit I uses 2 of the family's 3-pole shell positions; modeled here as a 2-cavity connector)

signals.name: ELO_145AB_RET
signals.description: Common return for the switch contact (connector pin 1).

signals.name: ELO_145AB_SW
signals.description: N.O. reed contact closes momentarily while button is pressed (Circuit I — no series resistor, no LED).

source_metadata.switching_current_derived_a: 0.28 (not explicitly stated; derived from 10 VA / 36 V)
source_metadata.connector_part_number_note: AMP-Super-Seal 3-pole shell shown in datasheet drawing; exact connector P/N not given for this product family (282105-1 is the related 145PTO product's connector P/N, NOT confirmed identical for this part) — verify before production use.
